objective: From the pre-approach decision state, generate the result of one complete 14.2-second block-placement macro before deciding continue or bank.
action_summary: 37 macro condition tokens: target xyz, normalized nominal time, macro id=1, approach offset=.08, clearance=.008. Not motor commands.
selection: Counts 1-6: first two stable source-training examples per count. Counts 7-10: first three source-training examples per outcome and count. Validation includes at least one stable example at every count, plus the first two examples per outcome at counts 8 and 10. Fixed before rendering.
conditioning: Current image/state/physics plus pre-action target and registered macro schedule; no realized future motor actions.
scope: Phase 1 known-validation feasibility, online-available conditioning. No new games yet.
loss: Inference-matched clean first latent, common future diffusion time, future-only loss with 16x weight in the dilated union of initial and target block regions.
checkpoint_rule: 720 updates, final checkpoint; stop as technical incomplete if time budget prevents 720. No validation selection.

phase1_gate.rule: All limits must hold on primary noise195; confirmation196 reported separately. Failure stops before phase2.
